FX-OPTICS-001.says: Field of view 90, horizontal, reverse off, the centre in the middle: a fisheye. The middle keeps its size and the stripes bow outward round it, squeezed more the farther out they are; the left and right edges read from past the drawing, so they and the corners are emptied.

FX-OPTICS-002.says: Field of view 0, as it starts: the drawing, untouched.

FX-OPTICS-003.says: Reverse on: the fisheye taken out, every pixel reading from nearer the middle, the stripes stretched outward, the empty right-hand column and top and bottom rows filled from inside.

FX-OPTICS-004.says: Vertical: the 90 degrees span the height, ten pixels, not the width, so the squeeze is stronger and more of the drawing is emptied than in FX-OPTICS-001.

FX-OPTICS-005.says: Diagonal: the 90 degrees span the diagonal, so the squeeze is gentler and less is emptied than in FX-OPTICS-001.

FX-OPTICS-006.says: Field of view 180, the most, reverse off: only the round part within eight pixels of the middle shows, squeezed hard toward its rim; every pixel farther out is empty.

FX-OPTICS-007.says: Field of view 180, reverse on: the whole picture reads from within eight pixels of the middle, stretched hard toward the edges.

FX-OPTICS-008.says: Centre 25, 50: the lens's middle at (4, 5), the left of the drawing kept and the right squeezed away.

FX-OPTICS-009.says: Centre 53.125, 55: the middle is the centre of pixel (8, 5) itself, so that pixel reads itself and is kept exactly.

FX-OPTICS-010.says: Field of view keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 120 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is the drawing, frame 2 is field of view 60 and frame 4 is 120.

FX-OPTICS-011.says: Centre keyed from 50, 50 at frame 0 to 25, 50 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is FX-OPTICS-001, frame 2 is centre 37.5, 50, and frame 4 is FX-OPTICS-008.

FX-OPTICS-012.says: Field of view eased from 90 at frame 0 to 180 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: at frame 2 it would pass 180, is held at 180, and is FX-OPTICS-006.

FX-OPTICS-013.says: FX-OPTICS-001 moved three pixels right: the lens moves with the drawing, and nothing grows.

FX-OPTICS-014.says: After a Motion Tile that grows the layer: the lens's middle and its span are still the drawing's own, so the stripes bow as in FX-OPTICS-001, but the edges now read the tiles around instead of emptiness.

FX-OPTICS-015.says: Field of view -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-OPTICS-016.says: Field of view 181, above 180. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-OPTICS-017.says: Orientation "sideways", which is not "horizontal", "vertical" or "diagonal". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-OPTICS-018.says: Reverse "yes", which is not "on" or "off". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-OPTICS-019.says: Centre 50, 1001, past ten heights. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-OPTICS-020.says: Field of view keyed to 200 at frame 4, above 180. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
